# Carousel Creative

> Carousel Creative is a research-driven performance creative agency helping brands scale through consumer psychology, Meta ad creative strategy, creative testing, and integrated media buying.

Founder: Leah Mazur

## Primary services
- Creative strategy
- Meta media buying
- Consumer research
- Creative testing
- Ad concept development
- Performance creative systems

## Key differentiators
- Research-backed creative strategy
- Consumer psychology expertise
- Integrated creative and media buying
- Creative diversity instead of chasing one winning ad
- Case-study-backed growth for ecommerce and performance-driven brands
